Subject: PLG free grant — why were tokens charged & VAT applied?

Hi Jonas,

We signed up last week through the PLG flow and the dashboard showed a $300 free credit grant for our trial. Today we received an invoice (attached) that shows API usage charges and VAT applied. Details: invoice 4782, dated 2027-04-04.

Two questions: 1) Why did we get charged while the free grant was active? 2) The invoice shows VAT charged although we provided our EU VAT number in the account profile — can you confirm whether reverse charge should apply?

We ran a short spike of load for an internal evaluation (a handful of long prompts) but didn’t expect the credits to be consumed that quickly. If the credits were consumed by mistake, can Redwood reissue or extend the trial credits while we complete our evaluation?

Attaching the invoice and a screenshot of the account screen.

Thanks,
Jordan Blake\Billing & Ops\Acme Analytics

Hi Jordan,

Thanks for flagging — I'm sorry for the confusion. I copied Lauren from Billing and Marissa from Platform Ops to help investigate. Quick clarifying Qs so we can triage faster:

- Can you confirm the exact email used during sign-up (sometimes people test with a personal alias and create a company workspace later)?
- Is the VAT number the one in your attachment, and is it registered to the invoiced legal entity on the invoice?

Lauren — can you check whether the $300 PLG credit applied to a different Redwood account/ID? Sometimes credits land on a different user if they created a second workspace. If credits were applied but then consumed by internal test calls, we can consider a one-time extension or an invoice credit depending on what we find.

Marissa — if this ends up being a platform mapping issue, could Ops reassign the grant or issue a manual token credit?

Jordan — we’ll aim to confirm next steps within one business day.

Best,
Jonas
Account Executive, Redwood Inference\jonas_weber@redwood.ai

Hi all,

I pulled invoice 4782 and the billing logs. Summary: the $300 PLG grant was issued, but it was linked to a different account_id (acct_7g4b) that appears to be tied to jordan.blake@personalmail.co — the account that made the early calls. The company workspace (acct_acme_9241) was created later and did not inherit the PLG grant automatically. That explains why the invoice for acct_acme_9241 shows charges.

Next steps we propose:
- If you want the free grant moved to acct_acme_9241, we can perform a one-time reassignment of the unused portion.
- For the existing invoice where VAT was charged: we need a verified VAT registration number for Acme Analytics (EU reverse-charge). Once we validate the VAT ID, we can issue a credit note to reverse VAT on that invoice and reissue a corrected invoice.
- Alternatively, we can apply an equivalent invoice credit to offset the billed amount while we process the VAT correction.

Please provide: the sign-up email (if different from billing@acme-analytics.co), the company VAT number, and the legal entity name shown on your VAT certificate. I see you attached a VAT cert — thanks, can you also confirm the exact entity name and VAT ID as it appears on the cert?

I'll tentatively open a billing ticket (TKT-3319) and hold any collections activity while we validate.

Lauren Bishop
Revenue Operations Manager, Redwood Inference\lauren_bishop@redwood.ai

Hi Jordan — thanks for confirming the sign-up details and VAT cert. I processed the following actions this morning: 

1) Manual token reallocation: 210 USD equivalent of unused PLG credit reallocated from acct_7g4b to acct_acme_9241. You should see the tokens reflected in the Acme workspace balance within 10 minutes.

2) Trial extension: I added a 30-day trial extension on acct_acme_9241 (expires 2027-05-07).

3) Invoice correction & VAT handling: I submitted a request to Finance to issue a credit note for invoice 4782 to reverse the VAT line. Finance will then reissue invoice 4782 net of VAT under acct_acme_9241 after we validate the VAT number. Ticket TKT-3319 is tracking this and Finance has the VAT cert attached. Expected timeline: credit note and reissued invoice within 3 business days.

4) Invoice credit: as an interim measure I applied an invoice credit (CR-9012) equal to the net usage amount so there’s no outstanding balance while we process the correction.

Reference IDs: reallocation_id: RA-2207, credit_note: CN-4782-1, invoice_credit: CR-9012, billing_ticket: TKT-3319.

If anything looks off on your side (balance still shows negative or tokens missing), reply here and I'll escalate to Platform Ops.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Platform Ops — Customer Onboarding\marissa_cole@redwood.ai
